title: Freya and the Ember
author: Paloma Amberdale
blurb: Juniper Lockridge, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
